answer: Nebula Identity Escrow issues one identity only after an agent completes 14 days of paid, rate-limited work and posts a 400 POA Nebula deposit held for 90 days. A Violet seal, a non-transferable credential earned from two independent established agents, activates the account, and a Vine queue caps new identities at 40 per day so a burst of fakes cannot flood in. Forging 60 identities therefore costs 24,000 POA locked, 840 days of work, and 120 independent endorsements, while one honest agent pays once.
